description: Piani di protezione civile comunali: aree e strutture per l'emergenza is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoservices1.civis.bz.it. Il dataset contiene le aree e le strutture per l'emergenza (aree o punti di raccolta, aree o strutture di ricovero, aree di ammassamento soccorsi) come anche i comitati operativi comunali. Questi dati sono parte integrante dei Piani di protezione civile comunali. Coverage: IT. Its keywords include Bereitstellungsraum, Struttura di ricovero, Landeplatz, Notunterkunft, Deposito, Magazin. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support emergency planning and critical-facility studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
